notes.title: Burger Station V1.4
notes.content: [p]Hello! I decided to update Burger Station in preparation for future versions. Burger Station will be recreated and revisualized from the ground-up in a new game engine. Additionally, I will use this as ground work for smaller game projects.[/p][p][/p][p]This last update *excluding bug fixes* should fix up most issues revolving the game's mechanics[/p][p]and dialogue automation.[/p][p][/p][p]1: General [/p][p]-SKIP cutscenes and dialogue. (Hold down SPACEBAR for a few seconds)[/p][p]-MAP: Indicates player location and level entrances/exits.[/p][p]-Starting level size increased to spread out interactive objects. [/p][p][/p][p]2: Enemy Adjustments[/p][p]-Player is given instructions in enemy cutscene.[/p][p]-Overall "spawn timer" has been extended for mild difficulty.[/p][p]-Enemy will "warn" players even earlier before spawning.[/p][p]-Player does not lose all keys upon GAME OVER.[/p][p]-Less terrain will spawn during mini-game to decrease the chances of cluttering between them.[/p][p][/p][p]3: Additional[/p][p]-Revision of "Burger Station" song[/p][p]-A few songs have been audio boosted to match the volume of other songs.[/p][p]-Small bug fixes[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Burger Station V1.1
notes.content:
Hi! Here are some very small fixes and adjustments. Thank you for playing and leaving a review if you did! 

-Adjusted "Tree Stranger" difficulty, still providing a decent challenge.
-Restored some more terrain to avoid exploration confusion during "Tree Stranger" sequence
-Added game control text to main menu
